en_title: George R.R. Martin Working on Dunk and Egg Book Four, A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Showrunner Says
cn_title: 乔治·R·R·马丁正创作第四部《邓肯与伊戈》小说
subtitle: 未发表手稿已被剧集采用

paragraphs.en: Game of Thrones mastermind and A Song of Ice and Fire author George R.R. Martin is working on a fourth Dunk and Egg book, according to A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms showrunner Ira Parker.
paragraphs.cn: 据《七王国的骑士》剧集统筹艾拉·帕克透露，《权力的游戏》主创、《冰与火之歌》作者乔治·R·R·马丁正在创作第四部《邓肯与伊戈》小说。

paragraphs.en: The HBO showrunner opened up about the future of the fantasy spinoff during an interview with The Hollywood Reporter . While his adaptation of Martin's Dunk and Egg stories has only received a green light for up to Season 2, he's stated in the past that he'd love to expand this live-action version of the tales of Ser Duncan the Tall (Peter Claffey) and Egg (Dexter Sol Ansell).
paragraphs.cn: 这位HBO剧集统筹接受《好莱坞报道者》采访时，谈到了这部奇幻衍生剧的未来。虽然马丁《邓肯与伊戈》故事的真人改编目前只获批制作到第二季，但他过去曾表示，希望继续扩展高个邓肯爵士（彼得·克拉菲饰）与伊戈（德克斯特·索尔·安塞尔饰）的冒险。

paragraphs.en: If all goes well, he's hoping to expand into three seasons "or maybe four or five." Part of what might help A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms move forward is if Martin can finish the next Dunk and Egg chapter on time.
paragraphs.cn: 如果一切顺利，他希望剧集能够扩展至三季，「甚至四季或五季」。若马丁能及时完成下一篇《邓肯与伊戈》故事，或许会帮助《七王国的骑士》继续推进。

paragraphs.en: "Book four, which George is working on, takes place in a very cool location," Parker teased. "And five is the last story point of Egg as a boy. So it’s a very natural ending place for us to take a break and come back when Dexter is older. So then we can do Egg the Prince, do some politics, do some fun stuff in Summer Hall and King’s Landing, and get a different vibe where they’re not on the road all the time."
paragraphs.cn: 帕克卖关子说：「乔治正在创作的第四部故事发生在一个非常酷的地点。第五部则是伊戈童年阶段的最后一个故事节点，所以那里很适合让剧集暂时告一段落，等德克斯特长大后再回来。之后我们就能讲述身为王子的伊戈，加入一些政治情节，在盛夏厅和君临城展开有趣故事，营造一种不再总是在路上的不同氛围。」

paragraphs.en: Martin has previously expressed his interest in continuing the Dunk and Egg series of novellas . For now, however, that wing of the Game of Thrones universe is limited to The Hedge Knight, The Sworn Sword, and The Mystery Knight. According to Parker, Martin is hoping to make that change, though he failed to elaborate on that "very cool location."
paragraphs.cn: 马丁此前曾表达继续创作《邓肯与伊戈》中篇小说系列的意愿。不过目前，《权力的游戏》宇宙的这条支线仅有《雇佣骑士》《誓言骑士》和《神秘骑士》三篇作品。帕克称马丁希望改变这一现状，但没有进一步透露那个「非常酷的地点」究竟是哪里。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Martin has, of course, been infamously reluctant to publish the penultimate installment in his A Song of Ice and Fire series, The Winds of Winter. Although he's not thrilled how long it's taken either , the 77-year-old author doesn't exactly have a backup plan if he's unable to finish it before he dies . Where this alleged fourth Dunk and Egg novella falls on the ever-expanding release timeline remains a mystery.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，众所周知，马丁迟迟没有出版《冰与火之歌》系列倒数第二部《凛冬的寒风》。这位77岁的作家本人也不满意作品耗时如此之久，但如果生前无法完稿，他似乎并没有明确的备用方案。因此，这部据称正在创作的第四篇《邓肯与伊戈》中篇小说会被排在不断延长的出版时间表何处，仍是未知数。

paragraphs.en: As for A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, Parker had expressed interest in taking a break between later seasons to allow the actors to age accordingly. It's an idea that HBO executives have mostly given him "eye rolls" over, though it sounds like they're "not completely" turned off by it.
paragraphs.cn: 至于《七王国的骑士》，帕克曾表示希望在后续季度之间暂停一段时间，让演员自然成长到合适年龄。HBO高管听到这个想法大多会对他「翻白眼」，不过他们似乎也没有「彻底」拒绝。

paragraphs.en: "So if the show wraps and people are still OK with everything we’re doing and there’s still an appetite," Parker continued, "let the show evolve along with our leads, with myself and with the rest of our creative team as we grow older and the world changes and we want to say different things. I think that would be a lovely way to tell a story about these two guys through the course of their lives."
paragraphs.cn: 帕克继续说道：「如果这一阶段的剧集结束后，大家仍认可我们的创作，也仍想看下去，那就让剧集与主演、与我、与创作团队一起演变。随着我们逐渐变老、世界发生变化，我们也会想表达不同的东西。我认为，以这种方式讲述这两个人贯穿一生的故事会非常美妙。」

paragraphs.en: Parker previously stated that, while he doesn't believe A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms seasons will outpace Martin's work, the author has at least provided the HBO team with 12 outlines for future stories . Although these were described as a rough look at the road ahead, it sounds like the Dunk and Egg show could continue for a while longer, should enough viewers ask for it.
paragraphs.cn: 帕克此前表示，他不认为《七王国的骑士》的制作进度会超过马丁的创作，但作者至少已经向HBO团队提供了12个未来故事大纲。尽管这些只被形容为对后续方向的粗略规划，但只要有足够多观众想看，《邓肯与伊戈》剧集似乎还能继续很长一段时间。

paragraphs.en: Parker also teased that he and the team have laid eyes on some of Martin's unpublished work.
paragraphs.cn: 帕克还透露，他和团队已经看过马丁的一些未发表作品。

paragraphs.en: "He gave me some unpublished pages — actual written prose he found in his files somewhere that he sent over, and we used them," he added.
paragraphs.cn: 他补充说：「他给了我一些未发表的书页——是真正写好的散文，是他从某个文件夹里翻出来发给我的，而我们已经把它们用进剧集。」

paragraphs.en: While we wait for more Dunk and Egg and continue waiting for The Winds of Winter, you can see what IGN thought of A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Season 1 in our 8/10 review . You can also check out the latest update on Season 2 .
paragraphs.cn: 在等待更多《邓肯与伊戈》故事、同时继续等待《凛冬的寒风》期间，你可以阅读IGN为《七王国的骑士》第一季给出8/10分的评测，也可以查看第二季的最新消息。

summary: 《七王国的骑士》统筹艾拉·帕克透露，乔治·R·R·马丁正在创作第四部《邓肯与伊戈》小说，并已向HBO提供12个未来故事大纲及部分未发表正文。剧集未来可能扩展至四五季，并随演员年龄成长调整时间线。
opus_summary: 马丁正在写第四篇《邓肯与伊戈》故事，还把未发表正文交给HBO使用。剧集统筹希望拍到四五季，并在伊戈童年篇结束后暂停，等待演员自然长大。
